stop_coverage_semantics.canonical_dual_stop: configured input and stop-policy coverage only; observed termination is separately receipted and this label does not claim either token was emitted
stop_coverage_semantics.stop_endoftext: configured input and stop-policy coverage only; observed termination is separately receipted and this label does not claim token 248044 was emitted
stop_coverage_semantics.stop_im_end: configured input and stop-policy coverage only; observed termination is separately receipted and this label does not claim token 248046 was emitted

prefill_schedules.one_token_calls: T calls consuming [i,i+1) for i=0..T-1 without sampling between calls
prefill_schedules.chunks_3_1_1_remainder: calls consuming [0,3), [3,4), [4,5), and [5,T), without sampling between calls

prediction_frame.prompt_call: call 0 consumes prompt positions [0,T) and predicts emitted token 0
prediction_frame.decode_call: call i>0 consumes emitted token i-1 at position T+i-1 and predicts emitted token i
prediction_frame.cache_length_after_call: T+i for call i, before the token predicted by that call enters the cache
prediction_frame.stop_policy: include a predicted stop token in emitted IDs and UTF-8, then perform no later forward call
prediction_frame.terminal_cache: does not contain the terminal token predicted by the final executed call

generation_prediction.call_span: prompt [0,T) for call 0; one emitted token for each later call

selections.prompt_hidden_positions: ascending(sorted_unique(0,2,3,4,T-1) intersect [0,logical_prefix)) at each snapshot; descriptor stores the exact concrete IDs

hidden_site_boundaries.embedding_output: token embedding lookup output before decoder layer 0 and before any decoder-layer normalization
hidden_site_boundaries.decoder_output_<i>: post-MLP-residual output returned by the complete decoder block i, after both attention-or-GDN and MLP residual updates and before layer i+1
hidden_site_boundaries.final_norm_output: output of the final text-model RMSNorm applied after decoder layer 63 and before lm_head

mlx_lm.capacity_constraint: L<=C<L+256; record actual C because nonaligned chunk growth need not be a multiple of 256

capacity_recurrence.no_growth: when L+N<=C, set L=L+N and leave C unchanged
capacity_recurrence.growth: when L+N>C, first set C=L if prior C>0 and L mod 256 != 0, then set C=C+ceil(N/256)*256 and L=L+N
capacity_recurrence.call_token_count: N is the positive token count in the current forward call

common_constraints.frame_ids: exactly <run_instance_id>/gen/<prediction_index> or <run_instance_id>/prefill/<logical_prefix>, with canonical unsigned decimal suffix and no leading zero except zero

digest_preimages.input_ids_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact bound input_ids payload bytes serialized as headerless C-contiguous u32le
digest_preimages.template_arguments_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the exact case template_args object before any runtime default expansion

events_jsonl.ordering: case_input_or_rejection_before_runs; within each run run_start then contiguous calls and attached snapshots then exactly one run_end
foreign_key_rules: every run case_id references one preceding case_input in the same arm; run_start.input_ids_sha256 equals that case input_ids descriptor sha256

case_input.prompt_tokens equals its input_ids tensor token-axis length T with 6<=T<=512; template_arguments_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the canonical JSON exact template-argument object bound by the case
every call, snapshot, and run_end references exactly one preceding run_start by run_instance_id with equal oracle_id case_id and run_id
every event payload path joins exactly one payload-manifest record with equal oracle_id case_id run_id run_instance_id frame_id and channel semantics
call_conditionals: generation_prediction requires sampled=true, integer predicted_token_id and prediction_index, and frame_id=run_instance_id/gen/<prediction_index>
teacher_forced_prefill requires sampled=false, prediction_index=null, is_stop=false, termination_reason=not_applicable, and frame_id=run_instance_id/prefill/<logical_prefix>
boundary_tag is null except at a declared snapshot boundary; each non-null tag has exactly one attached snapshot

is_stop=true iff predicted_token_id is in the run stop_token_ids; a terminal call uses termination_reason=stop_token iff is_stop=true, otherwise max_steps iff prediction_index=15, including when the sixteenth predicted token is also a stop

post_first_decode_call_if_executed.condition: emit only on the first generation decode call after the prompt call

terminal_call_if_distinct.condition: emit only when the terminal call is distinct from the calls already tagged post_prefill or post_decode

cardinality_and_sequence: exactly one case_input for every renderer-success case and exactly one render_rejection for every renderer-reject case; parser cases never appear in producer-owned arm events
exactly one run_start and one run_end for every case named by each run in the run-case matrix

call_index is contiguous from zero; the first call has call_token_start=cache_length_before=0; every call has cache_length_before=call_token_start and logical_prefix=call_token_end=cache_length_after; consecutive spans are contiguous and match the selected prefill schedule
behavior_monolithic and trace_monolithic execute one generation_prediction call per emitted token, with 1<=call_count=emitted_token_count<=16
trace_token_serial_prefill executes exactly T teacher_forced_prefill calls; trace_conv_boundary_prefill executes exactly four teacher_forced_prefill calls because T>=6
a stop-token call is terminal, is included in emitted payloads, and has no later call; max_steps terminates after exactly 16 emitted tokens
generation runs use max_steps and stop_token_ids exactly from case_plan.behavior_cases; no-decode prefill runs use max_steps=0 and stop_token_ids=[]

for generation runs run_end.termination_reason equals the terminal call termination_reason, call_count equals emitted_token_count, emitted_token_count equals the number of generation_prediction calls, and emitted_tokens_payload_path plus free_running_utf8_payload_path are both non-null and join exactly one run-end payload each
for no-decode prefill runs run_end has emitted_token_count=0, emitted_tokens_payload_path=null, free_running_utf8_payload_path=null, termination_reason=not_applicable, and terminal_cache_length=T
terminal_cache_length is T+emitted_token_count-1 for generation runs and T for no-decode prefill runs
every run_start asserts initial_cache_empty=true and initial_cache_offsets is the ordered 64-entry all-zero list before any call
snapshot boundaries and cardinality equal the selected run state_snapshots, using snapshot_specification_mapping for conditional specification names

field_types.axes_native_axes: arrays of nonempty unique axis-name strings
field_types.byte_length_call_index_call_spans_layer_: nonnegative JSON integers or null only where channel_rules permit
field_types.case_id_channel_frame_id_oracle_id_run_i: nonempty strings or null only where channel_rules permit
field_types.canonical_transform: one of identity, transpose_last_two, take_last_3_then_transpose_0_2_1, slice_token_axis_to_logical_offset
field_types.native_dtype: one of bfloat16, float32, int32, int64, uint32
field_types.selected_position_ids: ascending unique u32 JSON array or null
field_types.shape: nonempty array of positive concrete JSON integers

channel_rules: input_ids is case-level tensor site_or_role=input_sequence with all run frame call layer logical-offset and selected-position fields null
position_ids is call-level tensor site_or_role=logical_positions with non-null run frame call span and logical prefix; layer logical_offset and selected_position_ids are null
full_vocab_logits is call-level tensor site_or_role=last_position_logits with non-null run frame call span and logical prefix; layer logical_offset and selected_position_ids are null
greedy_token_ids is run-end tensor site_or_role=emitted_sequence with non-null run identity and all frame call layer logical-offset and selected-position fields null

selected_hidden_states is a snapshot tensor with a selected hidden site_or_role and layer null for embedding/final norm or the named decoder layer otherwise; prompt and teacher-forced snapshots use ascending(sorted_unique(0,2,3,4,T-1) intersect [0,logical_prefix)), while generation-decode snapshots use the singleton currently consumed absolute position T+prediction_index-1
native_gdn_recurrent_state and native_gdn_conv_state are snapshot tensors with site_or_role recurrent_state or conv_history and one selected GDN layer

native_full_attention_kv is a snapshot tensor with site_or_role K or V and one selected full-attention layer; mlx_lm logical_offset is non-null and both C and L exactly satisfy the frozen call-by-call capacity recurrence plus L<=C<L+256, Transformers logical_offset equals L
rendered_utf8 and render_rejection are case-level bytes with all run frame and call fields null and site_or_role rendered_prompt or rejection_record
topk is call-level canonical-json bytes with non-null run frame call and logical prefix and site_or_role ranked_logits_33
free_running_utf8 is run-end bytes with non-null run identity, null frame call and logical prefix, and site_or_role decoded_emitted_sequence
foreign_key_rules: every arm event payload path joins one descriptor with equal oracle case run instance frame and channel fields
every snapshot required_channel_id expands to the exact per-site per-layer channel inventory and joins one descriptor per expansion
no descriptor may reference a case run frame layer site or role outside the frozen case plan, run matrix, selections, and channel rules

field_types.adjacent_margins_f32: 31 finite JSON numbers equal to ranked_values_f32[i]-ranked_values_f32[i+1] after float32 rounding
field_types.cutoff_margin_f32: finite JSON number equal to ranked_values_f32[31]-rank_33_value_f32 after float32 rounding
field_types.rank_33_token_id: u32 token ID distinct from every ranked_token_ids entry
field_types.rank_33_value_f32: finite JSON number exactly representing the float32 rank-33 logit
field_types.ranked_token_ids: 32 unique u32 token IDs in descending float32 value then ascending token-ID order
field_types.ranked_values_f32: 32 finite JSON numbers exactly representing the ordered float32 logits

topk.verifier_rule: recompute every field from the bound full_vocab_logits payload and reject any mismatch

field_types.case_id: exact frozen renderer-reject case ID matching the event and manifest
field_types.native_exception_text: informational UTF-8 string or null; never used as the stable comparison authority
field_types.stable_rejection_code: exact case_plan.render_rejection_codes[case_id] value and exact event stable_rejection_code

payload_manifest_jsonl.shape_rule: tensor shapes contain only positive concrete JSON integers; symbolic dimensions are forbidden in produced bundles
payload_manifest_jsonl.tensor_byte_length_rule: byte_length=4*product(shape) with checked unsigned-64-bit multiplication for both f32le and u32le

field_types.actual_text: UTF-8 string preserving every non-tool byte exactly
field_types.actual_tool_calls: ordered canonical-JSON array of closed name-and-arguments objects
field_types.case_corpus_sha256_parser_harness_sha256: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact raw corpus and parser entrypoint bytes
field_types.expected_outcome_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing the case expected_text and expected_tool_calls

verifier_parser_outcomes_jsonl.cardinality: exactly one record for every parser case and no other case
verifier_parser_outcomes_jsonl.parser_harness_binding: every record uses one identical parser_harness_sha256; it equals the detached seal parser_harness_sha256 and the matching parser_harness_path entry in the comparison-harness inventory

field_types.comparison_harness_sha256: lowercase hex SHA-256 of a canonical path-byte_length-sha256 inventory for every verifier and comparison harness regular file
field_types.parser_harness_path: canonical relative path to the sole parser entrypoint within the comparison-harness inventory
field_types.parser_harness_sha256: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact parser_harness_path regular-file bytes and equal to every parser outcome record
field_types.producer_contracts_sha256: exact raw producer-contracts.json SHA-256 bound by contract.json
field_types.trace_schema_sha256: exact raw trace-schema.json SHA-256 bound by contract.json

parser_case: zero arm payloads; exactly one record in verifier/parser-outcomes.jsonl owned by the external project verifier
instrumented_snapshot: one selected_hidden_states f32le tensor for each of the ten selected site_or_role values
one native_gdn_recurrent_state and one native_gdn_conv_state f32le tensor for each of the four selected GDN layers
one native_full_attention_kv f32le tensor for each K and V site_or_role at each of the three selected full-attention layers
required_payload_inventory.forbidden: missing, extra, duplicate, cross-run, cross-case, cross-oracle, symbolic-shape, unmanifested, or unreferenced payloads

cross_oracle_comparison.cardinality: every required comparable logical event and payload record from either arm has exactly one counterpart in the other arm; unmatched missing extra or duplicate records are fatal
cross_oracle_comparison.descriptor_rule: joined exact channels have identical logical descriptors and bytes; joined numeric channels have identical stored dtype axes and logical shape after verifier-owned normalization, while native raw shape and axes remain receipted
cross_oracle_comparison.coverage: compare every applicable channel declared by comparison_metrics at every required case run frame call snapshot site and layer; subset selection is forbidden
cross_oracle_comparison.parser_rule: parser outcomes are verifier-owned shared evidence and are validated once rather than treated as two independent model-arm votes

state_diagnostics.scope: report per state channel layer frame and global maximum where a maximum is defined
